description: Logical-path edge cases for redaction: multiple sensitive fields whose values are all null must remain null (nothing to redact, and null must not become a string), a numeric-looking single-character string value is still redacted by length, values containing JSON metacharacters are redacted by their character count while a non-sensitive field carrying the same metacharacters passes through unchanged, and multi-byte values are redacted by their underlying byte length while non-sensitive multi-byte values pass through unchanged. Key order is preserved. The output is the resulting payload serialized as a JSON object.
